column2: it safely shuts itself down. But there's a few cases
which defeats the point of being safe (it crashes

column1: the kernel when an anomaly is found!). There's no reason for them. Switch
them all to either WARN_ON_ONCE() (when no ring buffer descriptor is present)
or to RB_WARN_ON() (when a ring buffer descriptor is present).
